# LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.56

Audit release (everything in pre.55 included: the hardware tutorial as a picture book and two clips).

- **Hardware tutorial corrected**: screen labels, profile names and claims were checked against the program; the nonexistent "phone photos" profile is gone, finger removal is described as optional (it is off by default), and an unverified background-cleaning claim was removed. PDFs rebuilt in eight languages.
- **Upside-down page detection** is stricter on degenerate input (empty, tiny or solid pages are never turned) and has tests for it.
- **OCR rescue pass** (lines Tesseract left out) is much faster on large pages: coverage is looked up in a mask instead of scanning every word for every dark pixel.
- **Licences**: the project owner confirmed Alexandru Dumbravă's agreement to use his diagram, photos and texts; recorded in `docs/audit/assets-licences.md` (no written document is kept in the repository).

Known limits: the rescue pass and the automatic upside-down detection are tested on synthetic pages and a few photos, not on a large real corpus; detection works for Latin-script text only and needs at least 12 text lines on the page.
